transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Well... I guess what really scared me enough to finally come in today is... I just keep thinking that it would be a relief if I didn't wake up. You know, if I just went to sleep and that was it. I haven't tried to hurt myself or do anything like that, but... having those thoughts just really frightened me.
Have you had any intention of ending your life?

No, like I was just saying... I don't have any real intention or plan to do it. I haven't tried to hurt myself at all. It's really just that feeling I mentioned, where I keep thinking it would be such a relief to just not wake up. I don't actually want to kill myself, but having those thoughts sitting there in my head is what scared me enough to come get help.
Have you been feeling depressed most days?
Yes, I have. Most mornings I just wake up with this heavy sadness in my chest. It's like... like I've already failed the day before it even starts.
Have you had a similar period of depression like this at any other time in your life?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had sad days before, like anyone else, but... never anything like this. This is the first time it's been this bad, where it just doesn't go away.
Did something stressful happen in your life shortly before these feelings started?
Well, I suppose it started about four months ago. That's when my aunt moved in to live with us. It's been going on ever since then.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. I used to really look forward to my watercolors, and going to dance class, or just walking with the ladies. But lately... I just leave my painting things sitting there. I just can't seem to make myself care about any of it anymore.
Do these feelings seem mainly related to your aunt moving in?
I'm not really sure. I mean, it started right around the time she got here, but... I don't know if it's actually because of her. It's hard to say. I just know they happened at the same time.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite?
No, I haven't really noticed any change there. I still eat my regular meals, so... my appetite seems about the same as it always is.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
No, my sleep has been fine, really. I still go to bed around the same time and wake up when I usually do. So, no trouble there.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
No, not really. I haven't noticed any problems with that. I can still pay attention to things just fine, like if I'm watching TV or just doing things around the house. So my focus seems okay.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy?

Yeah, actually, I have. Even after a full night in bed, my body just feels worn out. It seems like just doing normal things around the house, like carrying a basket of laundry or making breakfast... it takes a lot more out of me than it should.
Have you been feeling worthless or like you've let people down?

Yeah, I do. Sometimes when I feel tired or get annoyed with my aunt, I just... I start thinking I'm a bad woman. I get it in my head that I'm bringing shame on my family because I should be more grateful.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual?

Well, my husband says I do. He tells me I move like everything takes extra effort now. And I guess I do notice it when I go to the market... I'll just stand there way too long before I actually pick up what I came for.
Because of how you've been feeling, have you been having trouble keeping up with your usual daily activities?

Yeah, I have. I just... I've stopped going to my dance class and my walking group. I even stopped doing my shifts at the food pantry. And since I get stuck and just fall behind on everything, my husband has had to take over a lot more of the errands for me.
